# A2A v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir implementation of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol

## Pages

- [A2A](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Contributing](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [Elixir A2A — Roadmap](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/spec.md)
- [LICENSE](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [A2A.Agent](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Agent.md): Behaviour for defining A2A agents.
- [A2A.AgentCard](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.AgentCard.md): Decoded agent card from the A2A discovery endpoint.
- [A2A.AgentSupervisor](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.AgentSupervisor.md): Supervisor for a fleet of A2A agents with an integrated registry.
- [A2A.Artifact](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Artifact.md): An output produced by an agent in response to a task.
- [A2A.Event](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Event.md): Streaming events emitted during task execution.
- [A2A.Event.ArtifactUpdate](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Event.ArtifactUpdate.md): A streaming event indicating an artifact was produced or appended.

- [A2A.Event.StatusUpdate](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Event.StatusUpdate.md): A streaming event indicating a task status change.

- [A2A.FileContent](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.FileContent.md): Represents file content with either inline bytes or a URI reference.
- [A2A.JSON](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.JSON.md): Codec for converting between Elixir structs and the A2A v0.3 camelCase JSON wire format.
- [A2A.JSONRPC](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.JSONRPC.md): Transport-agnostic JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch layer for the A2A protocol.
- [A2A.JSONRPC.Error](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.JSONRPC.Error.md): JSON-RPC 2.0 error with A2A-specific error codes.
- [A2A.Message](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Message.md): A single turn of communication between user and agent.
- [A2A.Part](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Part.md): Typed content parts used in messages and artifacts.
- [A2A.Part.Data](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Part.Data.md): A structured data content part.

- [A2A.Part.File](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Part.File.md): A file content part.

- [A2A.Part.Text](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Part.Text.md): A text content part.

- [A2A.Registry](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Registry.md): Agent discovery registry backed by ETS.
- [A2A.SecurityScheme](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.md): Union type over the five A2A security scheme types.
- [A2A.SecurityScheme.APIKey](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.APIKey.md): API key security scheme.
- [A2A.SecurityScheme.HTTPAuth](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.HTTPAuth.md): HTTP authentication security scheme (e.g. Bearer, Basic, Digest).

- [A2A.SecurityScheme.MutualTLS](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.MutualTLS.md): Mutual TLS (mTLS) security scheme.

- [A2A.SecurityScheme.OAuth2](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.OAuth2.md): OAuth 2.0 security scheme.

- [A2A.SecurityScheme.OpenIDConnect](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.SecurityScheme.OpenIDConnect.md): OpenID Connect security scheme.

- [A2A.Task](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Task.md): A unit of work managed by an agent runtime.
- [A2A.Task.Status](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Task.Status.md): The current status of a task, including state, optional message, and timestamp.

- [A2A.Telemetry](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by the A2A library.

- Core
  - [A2A](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.md): Elixir implementation of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.

- Storage
  - [A2A.TaskStore](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.TaskStore.md): Behaviour for pluggable task persistence.
  - [A2A.TaskStore.ETS](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.TaskStore.ETS.md): ETS-backed task store implementation.

- HTTP
  - [A2A.Client](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Client.md): HTTP client for consuming remote A2A agents.
  - [A2A.Plug](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Plug.md): Plug for serving A2A agents over HTTP.
  - [A2A.Plug.Auth](https://a2a.hexdocs.pm/A2A.Plug.Auth.md): Plug middleware for A2A agent authentication.
